intro: Popular Monster Hunter Wilds mods updated after Ver.1.042 (August 2026). Most are on Nexus Mods and need REFramework; install it first, then use Fluffy Mod Manager for the rest. Capcom doesn't support mods, so uninstall them before each title update.

mods.name: REFramework
mods.summary: praydog's mod framework for RE Engine games. Every script mod for Wilds needs it.
mods.note: Download REFramework.zip and extract only dinput8.dll next to MonsterHunterWilds.exe. If the newest nightly crashes, try the previous one.

mods.name: CatLib
mods.summary: Shared scripts and resources used by several popular editor mods. Does nothing on its own.

mods.name: HunterPie
mods.summary: Overlay showing monster health, parts, ailments, your damage meter and buff timers, without editing game files.
mods.note: Standalone app (needs the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime), not an REFramework mod; its release notes name the Wilds version they support.

mods.name: Monster Weakness Icon Indicator
mods.summary: Shows which elements each monster is weak to as icons on the HUD.
mods.note: Install it with Fluffy Mod Manager; higher-priority texture mods can hide the icons.

mods.name: Auto Skip Kill Cam (Fast Return)
mods.summary: Skips the kill camera and, optionally, the carve timer and quest-end scenes.
mods.note: Options are in the REFramework menu (Insert key).

mods.name: Disable Post-Processing Effects
mods.summary: Turn off or tune post-processing such as TAA, color correction, sharpening and film grain.

mods.name: RenoDX (HDR and SDR fix)
mods.summary: Rewrites the game's color grading to fix SDR and HDR, with controls for tone mapping, paper white and UI brightness.
mods.note: Needs ReShade with full add-on support; it's an add-on, not a ReShade effect preset.

mods.name: Wilds Rehydrated
mods.summary: Color and lighting preset with deeper colors and shadows that removes the yellow tint, for SDR and HDR.
mods.note: Also needs ReShade with add-on support.

mods.name: Permanent Event Quests and Custom Quest Loader
mods.summary: Keeps Capcom's time-limited event quests playable any time, offline too, and loads custom quests.
mods.note: Capcom warns against modified quests online; play these solo.

mods.name: No Crafting Requirements
mods.summary: Sets material requirements for weapons, armor, talismans and Palico gear to zero.
mods.note: Single player only. The loose-file version needs Fluffy Mod Manager's loose file loader.

mods.name: Artian Editor
mods.summary: Edit the bonuses on Artian weapons from the REFramework menu.
mods.note: Single player only. Open it under Script Generated UI in the REFramework menu.

mods.name: Charm Editor
mods.summary: Edit talisman skills and slots; a Valid Check option keeps you to combinations the game can roll.
mods.note: Single player only. Open it under Script Generated UI in the REFramework menu.

mods.name: Obsolete Mod Detector (Blackscreen Fixer)
mods.summary: Scans your mods for files that are likely outdated after a title update, a common cause of black screens.
mods.note: Needs the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime. It's a best guess, so test the mods it flags.
